trial_court: Principal Judge, Family Court, Guna in M.Cr.C. No.83/2014
case_name: Smt. Sapna Shrivastava vs Shiv Om Shrivastava
acts_cited_auto: Protection of Women from DV Act, 2005

acts_cited.act: Protection of Women from DV Act, 2005

facts_of_case: The applicant filed an application under Section 125 of Cr.P.C. on the ground that she is the legally wedded wife of the respondent having married to him on 13/4/2012 as per Hindu rites and rituals. The respondent started harassing the applicant because of non-fulfillment of their demand of dowry.

legal_principles.principle: A husband's personal obligation to maintain his wife is not disentitled by her being a qualified lady.
legal_principles.held: Merely because the wife is a qualified lady would not ipso facto dis-entitle her to claim maintenance from her husband.

legal_principles.principle: A party's conduct cannot be ignored by the court in determining their entitlement to relief.
legal_principles.held: The conduct of the respondent was ignored by the trial Court because

outcome.final_order: The application filed by the applicant under Section 125 of Cr.P.C. has been dismissed.
